verdict.rationale: Motion has a documented REST API for tasks/projects (with live auth enforcement) and llms.txt exposing docs to agents, which is a rudimentary tool-calling surface, but there is no evidence of an MCP server, nor of API endpoints specifically exposing availability, bookings, or event types (only task/project CRUD is documented). Missing for 10: an MCP server implementation, documented booking/availability/event-type API endpoints, and any agent-specific tool-calling examples for scheduling actions.
